description: Extract queryVendors, queryVendor, updateVendorCore and deactivateVendorCore into packages/inventory/src/lib/vendors.ts; vendorActions.ts calls them
Extract queryVendorProducts and deleteVendorProductCore into packages/inventory/src/lib/vendorProducts.ts; vendorProductActions.ts calls them
GET /api/v1/inventory/vendors lists vendors with pagination, name search and include_inactive
POST /vendors creates a vendor through createVendorCore
A vendor name that matches an existing vendor after normalization is refused with 409
PUT /vendors/{vendorId} updates vendor fields including is_active
GET /vendors/{vendorId}/products lists the vendor price list with product name and SKU
PUT /vendors/{vendorId}/products/{serviceId} upserts a price list entry through upsertVendorProductCore
DELETE /vendors/{vendorId}/products/{serviceId} removes a price list entry
Routes enforce vendor read, create and update permissions; 'vendor' added to InventoryApiResource
Zod request schemas for vendor create, vendor update and price list upsert
All new routes registered in inventoryV1.ts with request body schemas
